messages:
Asha: Hey team — quick check before tonight's gradual release. Ben, you're on deploy tonight?
Ben: Yup. Targeting 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m holds. Staggered by geo buckets.
Asha: OK. Which cohorts exactly?
Ben: us-east-1 (1%), eu-west-1 (5% after health), apac-lite (5% but limited), then global (25/100). Full cohort list in config below.
Jordan: @Ben who's owning smoke and rollback?
Ben: Jordan + Diego will run smoke checks. Rollback owner is me; Jordan will coordinate DB/infra prechecks. Diego will monitor traces.
Diego: I'll be on standby 21:30-23:30 UTC. Smoke steps:
  1) curl -sf https://staging.metrics/redwood/health || fail
  2) run smoke.sh against /v1/generate with test prompt
  3) check error-rate <0.5%
Maya: Monitoring links?
Asha: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/3187654321/overview
Asha: Once 1% stable for 15m, we push 5% next. If any sig regressions, back to previous model/config and notify #incidents.
Ben: Deploy command I'll run:
```bash
./deploy --flag 'canary_ramp=1,5,25,100' --cohorts 'us-east-1,eu-west-1,apac-lite' --interval-min 15 --tag release/2026-03-17-tarmac
```
ops-bot: scheduled deploy at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z by Ben. Reminder DM to owners 20m prior.
Jordan: I'll prep canary smoke ticket and post checklist 20:30 UTC.
Asha: One more: keep KV-cache warm for us-east before ramp. Ben, add prewarm job.
Ben: Will trigger prewarm at 21:50 UTC; command: /prewarm --model=redwood-xl --cohort=us-east-1
Diego: If rollback needed, I'll coordinate traffic-shift to previous version and run post-rollback sanity.
Maya: @Asha add me to pager for first 45m of ramp.
Asha: done. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Ben: See you at 22:00. Ping if anything changes.
